newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish SILF purchasing managers' index 53.3 Jan.
newsitem.headline: Swedish SILF purchasing managers' index 53.3 Jan.

text.p: The SILF/Sparbanken purchasing managers' index was 53.3 in January, up from 50.3 in December.

"The total index developed positively in January...This points to a constant calm recovery of the economy. Only when there are signs of a more constant purchasing index level we can hope for a more remarkable strengthening of the economy," Sparbanken said in a statement.
It said the index was overall positive, but still cautioned against over enthusiasm.
"The increase for the month of January was positive. There is not reason for rejoicing. The total index of 53.3 is almost the exact same as the average over the previous six months (53.1)," it said.
"Clearly a more remarkable trend of a higher index is necessary for a few months before any conclusions about a stronger economy can be drawn," it said.
